changelog: - **No stray text selection in the bars, no frame round the first screen's title.** A drag that starts between the menus, on a tool-row label such as Connect, or on the status bar no longer selects their words, which a canvas click could not clear; panels, menus, fields and help text select as before. Clicking the title of the first screen (Before Loop Studio opens) no longer draws a focus frame round it; Tab still shows the focus on its buttons and boxes.
